title: Every deterministic equal-magnitude cube orbit has a universal fourth-defect floor

defect_floor.pattern: Let R_N have arbitrary deterministic unit-modulus coefficients on d_N complete-cube modes and I_(4,N)=int |R_N|^4>=0.
defect_floor.moments: Uniform translation and global phase give E M_N(x)^2=A_N^2d_N and E M_N(x)^4=(3/2)A_N^4I_(4,N).
defect_floor.scope_guard: Nonnegativity of I_4 is pattern-blind and proves neither flatness nor independence; unequal magnitudes and non-orbit laws remain outside the result.
